login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Welcome back. Sign in to your clinic workspace.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentDescription: If an account exists for this address, a reset link is on its way. The link is valid for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Your new password replaces the old one and signs you out on all devices.
reset.doneDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.

invitation.title: Activate your account
invitation.lead: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
invitation.doneDescription: You can now sign in with your email address and new password.

invalidLink.title: This link can no longer be used
invalidLink.reset: Reset links are valid for one hour and can be used once. Request a new link to continue.
invalidLink.invitation: Invitation links are valid for 72 hours and can be used once. Ask your clinic owner to send a new invitation.

passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
